findings.title: HTTP Request Smuggling via mitmproxy 6.0.2
findings.description: HTTP Request Smuggling vulnerability in mitmproxy 6.0.2 allows attackers to smuggle requests to backend services. CL.TE desync confirmed - mitmproxy reads Content-Length while backend reads Transfer-Encoding.
findings.evidence: Smuggled requests return 405/404 responses from backend, confirming HRS is working. Architecture: haproxy 2.0.5 -> mitmproxy 6.0.2 -> Apache/Flask -> internal.router (172.20.0.5:8001)
